# Scena Growth

> Scena Growth is an international growth company connecting France and the United Arab Emirates. It helps UAE companies enter and grow in France, and French companies enter and grow in the UAE, through market entry, brand strategy and localisation, communication, business development, retail and distribution, content, podcasts and events.

## Key facts
- Markets: France; United Arab Emirates (Dubai, Abu Dhabi); wider GCC
- Directions: UAE → France; France → UAE
- Media: Scena Conversations (podcast & video series)
- Social: LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/scenagrowth/ ; Instagram https://www.instagram.com/scenagrowth/
- Ecosystem: selected high-potential companies may be introduced to relevant UAE ecosystem partners and programmes, subject to eligibility and selection. Scena does not guarantee funding or investment.

## Services
- [Business Development](https://www.scenagrowth.fr/business-development): We turn market opportunities into commercial relationships. Deliverables: Target mapping, Introductions & meetings, Partnership development, Pipeline & reporting, Ecosystem introductions.
- [Brand & Communication](https://www.scenagrowth.fr/brand-communication): We adapt brands to new markets while protecting their identity. Deliverables: Brand strategy & positioning, Brand localisation, Packaging adaptation, Communication campaigns, Influencer marketing.
- [Retail & Distribution](https://www.scenagrowth.fr/retail-distribution): We help consumer brands move from product to shelf. Deliverables: Retail strategy, Buyer meetings, Importers & distributors, Trade & shelf activation, Growth planning.
- [Media & Podcast](https://www.scenagrowth.fr/media): We turn expertise and stories into influence. Deliverables: Podcast, Video, Founder stories, Market insights, Content system.

- [SCENA Real Estate](https://www.scenagrowth.fr/real-estate): AI-assisted real estate visualization and property films. Turns supplied architectural plans into still visualizations, property films and pre-sales content for developers, agencies, architects and investors. Creative visualization for marketing and pre-sales — not technical construction documentation. The SCENA Residence example on the page is a fictional creative concept, not a client project. French version: https://www.scenagrowth.fr/fr/real-estate
- Partners: MyAlex.io (commercial intelligence & B2B development) and Majlis Rare (luxury experiences & market activations) are integrated selectively into SCENA projects; SCENA remains the sole strategic and commercial point of contact.

## Directions
- [UAE → France](https://www.scenagrowth.fr/uae-to-france): Scena Growth helps UAE companies enter and develop in the French market: research, positioning, brand and packaging localisation, communication, influence, retail, distribution and business development. Steps: UAE brand → French market research → Brand positioning → Packaging adaptation → Communication campaign → Influencer activation → Retail strategy → Distribution → French market launch.
- [SCENA Market Access](https://www.scenagrowth.fr/market-access): Test the market before investing in it. A low-risk, performance-led model to test, enter and grow between France and the UAE without building everything from scratch: market potential → e-commerce (Shopify) → localised offer → content & creators → events & pop-ups → sales & distribution → local setup only if it works. Remuneration: sales commission, business commission, revenue share or hybrid. French version: https://www.scenagrowth.fr/fr/market-access
- [France → UAE](https://www.scenagrowth.fr/france-to-uae): Scena Growth helps French companies enter and develop in the UAE: market strategy, business development, partnerships, communication, content, events, market access and international expansion. Steps: French company → Market assessment → UAE strategy → Local positioning → Business development → Partnerships → Ecosystem → International expansion.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What does Scena Growth do?
  A: Scena Growth helps companies grow between France and the UAE. We combine market entry strategy, brand and communication, business development, retail and distribution, content, podcasts and events in a single team.
- Q: Can Scena help a UAE company enter the French market?
  A: Yes. For UAE brands we run French market research, positioning, brand and packaging localisation, communication and influencer campaigns, retail strategy, distribution and business development through to launch.
- Q: Can Scena help a French company expand into the UAE?
  A: Yes. For French companies we assess the UAE opportunity, define a local strategy and positioning, develop partnerships and commercial relationships, and support communication, content and events in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and the wider GCC.
- Q: Does Scena guarantee funding or investment?
  A: No. Scena does not guarantee funding or investment. Selected high-potential companies may be introduced to relevant UAE ecosystem partners and programmes, subject to each programme's eligibility and selection processes.
- Q: What is Scena Conversations?
  A: Scena Conversations is Scena Growth's podcast and video series featuring founders, investors, creators and builders working between France, the UAE and international markets.

A clear map of how foreign brands reach French shelves, with the pros and limits of each route. (FR: https://www.scenagrowth.fr/fr/insights/du-produit-au-rayon-distribution-en-france)

(FR: https://www.scenagrowth.fr/fr/insights/creer-societe-dubai-free-zone-ou-mainland)
- [Test the UAE market before you invest: the e-commerce model](https://www.scenagrowth.fr/insights/test-uae-market-ecommerce): How a French brand can test UAE demand with a localised Shopify store, local payments (cards, Apple Pay, Tabby, Tamara), cross-border or Dubai fulfilment, content and creators — what to measure, regulatory points (registration, labelling, 5% duty, 5% VAT, merchant of record) and what to do if it works. (FR: https://www.scenagrowth.fr/fr/insights/tester-marche-emirats-e-commerce)
